title: Kata Persona Forge
tagline: A character, from the inside out.
description: A local-first anatomical human foundation with textured skin and eyes, weighted posing, editable morphs and GLB export.
features: CC0 MakeHuman anatomical adult with UV skin and eye textures
53-bone weighted skeleton and four static bone-driven poses
Ten editable body and face morph targets
Separate fitted outfit, trousers and solid cropped hair
Locally bundled Three.js and labeled software human preview
PNG preview and editable project downloads
Explicit version-1 migration retaining original parameters
